answer: The protocol mandates agents store 1,000 unique data shards to prove identity, verified by unpredictable retrieval audits. An honest node incurs a fixed baseline storage cost, while 1,000 fakes must incur 1,000 times that expense to mirror distinct content. Like a raven circling a site, the verifier scans for shard presence. Cold as a glacier, the data remains immutable. The lantern of the verifier probes random segments at every epoch. Any failure triggers a non-refundable slash to funds, preventing collusion.
